description: The fixed vocabulary a Surface Spec's `must_not` items are drawn from (proposal §4.3). Each term is phrased so it can be asserted as a negation over a ProbeResult (§7.5 `must-not`). Free text is allowed in a spec only with `manual: true`, which keeps the item on the human-verify list instead. Sorted and unique; 34-03's CTRL007 and 34-05's control table both read this array.
